title: Too stiff. Made them awkward to use
text:
Too stiff. Made them awkward to use. These bags were a little different from brining bags I have used in the past.
These were thick and stiff. They closed with a zip-style top, and had a small plastic strip along the top to help the grooves click in together.

If I had to describe it, it was more like a space storage bag than a brining bag.
I found them to be awkwardly stiff. This made them harder to handle once the turkey was in the bag, and harder to place in the refrigerator. We had to fiddle with the top of the bag several times to get it to lay down enough to fit on the shelf.

After brining, it was equally awkward to handle. It took two of us to maneuver it to the sink. I couldn't get it to open correctly, so ended up just cutting the corner of the bag to let the brine drain out.

I would NOT buy this bag again. Just too stiff to be useable.
